protocol_basis: Run immutability forbids amendment, substitution, or post-capture population changes within the source run. The public method contains no rule that consumes an undisclosed seal upon preregistration alone. Therefore identical sealed bytes may be referenced by a separate pre-capture run with a new candidate binding.
fail_closed_condition: Any evidence of prior capture, prompt disclosure, response, grade, adjudication, result, dataset-byte drift, or holdout-content disclosure invalidates this determination before capture.
